name: dar-aviso
prompt: Documentary photograph, rural León, Spain. A woman in her seventies stands in the doorway of an adobe village house, holding a smartphone up in both hands, the screen facing the camera straight on. THE PHONE SCREEN IS COMPLETELY BLANK PURE WHITE, a flat empty white rectangle with no icons, no text, no user interface whatsoever. Her expression is urgent but composed. Behind her, across flat wheat fields, a column of grey smoke rises. Warm late-afternoon light, dusty ochre and straw tones, muted green shutters. Natural reportage style, shallow depth of field, no text anywhere in the image.
